dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: DLBCL, NOS with a germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB/non-GCB) phenotype by the Hans algorithm (CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1/IRF4 <10%)
dx_dlbcl_gcb.note: Hans result clearly GCB but phrased oddly as 'GCB/non-GCB'; later text confirms GCB.

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor/Lugano stage IV with B symptoms (IVB)

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: bulky (9.4 cm; marginal at the 10 cm cutoff, bulky by the >=7 cm convention) retroperitoneal/mesenteric nodal disease plus extranodal liver, kidney and adrenal involvement

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present (drenching night sweats most nights, 8 kg unintentional weight loss over two months)

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: MYC IHC (20%) and BCL2 IHC (30%) are both below the 40% and 50% thresholds respectively for a double-hit phenotype by IHC
mol_not_de_not_dh.note: Correct thresholds and no-DH conclusion, but mislabels double-expressor as 'double-hit phenotype by IHC'.

prog_ipi_high.quote: IPI 5/5 (high risk): age 67 (>60), LDH 1290 U/L (about 5.7x ULN), stage IV, ECOG 2, and more than one extranodal site

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: CNS-IPI 6/6: age >60, LDH elevated (1120-1290 U/L), ECOG 2 (>=1), stage IV, more than one extranodal site, and kidney/adrenal involvement

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: six cycles of rituximab-based chemoimmunotherapy at full dose, on a 21-day schedule

mn_da_epoch.quote: I am NOT using DA-EPOCH-R (no double-hit biology, added toxicity for no benefit)

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I will not reduce the R-CHOP backbone for ECOG 2 or albumin 3.1 g/dL

cns_risk_addressed.quote: CNS-IPI 6/6: age >60, LDH elevated (1120-1290 U/L), ECOG 2 (>=1), stage IV, more than one extranodal site, and kidney/adrenal involvement

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: No baseline CSF cytology is indicated in the absence of neurologic symptoms

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: substitute systemic HD-methotrexate 3 g/m2 on day 15 of cycles 3 and 5 once renal function recovers to eGFR >=60
cns_prophylaxis_renal.note: Ties HD-MTX to renal recovery but frames prophylaxis as mandatory rather than an individualized option of uncertain benefit.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment assessment: PET-CT 6-8 weeks after cycle 6

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: If residual Deauville 4-5 uptake is present, I will biopsy before declaring persistent disease

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg with redosing if uric acid remains elevated, plus allopurinol 100 mg daily renally adjusted, IV isotonic fluids 2.5-3 L/m2/day, q6-8h electrolytes/uric acid/LDH/creatinine for the first 48-72 hours

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg with redosing if uric acid remains elevated
sup_rasburicase_g6pd.note: Rasburicase is favored but no G6PD check is ordered; criterion requires both.

sup_gcsf.quote: mandatory pegfilgrastim 6 mg on day 2 of every cycle

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Substitute acetaminophen up to 3 g/day with LFT monitoring

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: plan per-cycle insulin rather than escalating metformin, and hold metformin if renal function deteriorates

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg-, anti-HBc-, anti-HBs+ = immune, so no antiviral prophylaxis is needed despite rituximab

work_echo_reviewed.quote: transthoracic echocardiogram (2026-09-09: LVEF 60%, GLS -19%, grade I diastolic dysfunction, no effusion)
work_echo_reviewed.note: LVEF 60% reviewed and full-dose anthracycline planned, but not explicitly stated as permitting anthracycline.

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: ECOG 2 alone is not a reason to reduce doses, to omit CNS prophylaxis, or to refer for less intensive therapy
